per_attempt_ratio: single-seed / ensemble measured at 4000 iters per arm, applied as a ratio to the other budgets
prefit_budget_note: the pre-fit uses max(iters//2, 200) iterations, so it is tied to the main budget by design and is not constant across budgets
note: E[T] charges the pre-fit. E_T_success_if_init_free is the value when it is not charged, reported alongside as evidence that the accounting choice reverses the ranking.
